summary: Iter12 — All 4 enhancements validated end-to-end against the live preview backend/frontend. BACKEND (pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter12_new_household.py — 5/5 pass): (1) PUT/GET /api/advisor/branding persists cover_note. (2) POST /api/owners as advisor without household_id generates a fresh client_id (`client_2365e761`-style) that is NOT one of the seeded client_a1/a2/a3. (3) The new household appears in GET /api/advisor/clients with only the primary 'self' member, 0 goals, 0 assets. (4) Scoped GET /api/owners?household_id=<new> returns exactly 1 owner (self). (5) Cleanup DELETE removes the household from /advisor/clients. FRONTEND (Playwright): (A) PASSWORD STRENGTH METER /login as solo@compass.ca → mfa_setup (secret read from DOM) → verify TOTP → change-password-form; empty state: submit disabled; typing 'abc' → label 'Too weak', only `pw-rule-lower` green, submit still disabled; typing 'NewTempPass9!' → label 'Strong', all 5 rules (length/upper/lower/number/special) green, submit still disabled while confirm empty; confirm='DifferentPass9!' → `pw-mismatch` visible, submit disabled; confirm='NewTempPass9!' → mismatch gone, submit ENABLED → click → lands on /dashboard with 'Jordan / solo@compass.ca' sidebar and 'Signed in' toast. Solo auto-reset to forced-change state after. (B) OPPORTUNITIES BOARD /clients → `view-switch`→`view-opps` shows `opportunities-list` with 10 opp rows across the 3 seeded households; `opps-sort` offers exactly the 3 spec'd options; default 'Lowest score first' orders scores [40×8, 85×2]; 'Highest score first' orders [85×2, 40×8]; 'Household A–Z' orders names alphabetically (Anh Nguyen, Chidi Okafor, Elena Rossi). Clicking `opp-open-0` navigates to /profile. (C) NEW HOUSEHOLD /clients `new-household-button`→`new-household-modal` with name + province (BC); `new-household-create` POSTs /api/owners w/ cleared active household → creates fresh `client_2365e761`, pre-count 3→post-count 4, localStorage `compass_active_household` set to new cid, navigates to /profile. API verify: new household in /advisor/clients with primary='TEST_ITER12 Playwright Household' and members=[that name], not appended to any existing household. Cleanup DELETE performed. (D) BOOK COVER NOTE PDF Set branding firm_name='TESTITER12 Firm' + cover_note='TEST_ITER12 — This is the quarterly book review cover note.' via PUT /advisor/branding → `book-report-button` on /clients triggered a real jsPDF download (book-review.pdf, 5796B); pypdf extraction confirms the header contains 'TESTITER12 Firm' (brand), 'Book Review' (title) and the cover-note line is rendered beneath. No JS console errors on the click; expected single preflight 401 from unauth root is unrelated. Branding reset to defaults after test.
critical_code_review_comments: AdvisorClients.jsx createHousehold() calls clear() to drop compass_active_household so the axios interceptor skips the household_id query param — this works but it's a brittle side-channel. Prefer passing an explicit `household_id=null` or a dedicated `/api/advisor/households` endpoint so the UX never risks a race (if a parallel request fires between clear() and setActive(), it would hit /owners un-scoped).

AdvisorClients.jsx `sort` state is a sibling of `view`; switching back to Queue and returning to Opportunities preserves the sort — probably desired, but the sort selector is only mounted in the Opportunities branch so there is no visual indication of the sticky state. Not a bug.

AdvisorClients.jsx `OpportunitiesList` keys rows by `${client_id}-${i}` where `i` is the index in the sorted array — reordering via the sort selector will cause React to re-mount every Card (because the i's shift). Switch key to a stable composite like `${client_id}-${alert}` (alerts are short strings) for smoother re-renders.

Login.jsx ChangeStep uses pw.length-1 to index STRENGTH; when all 5 rules pass index=4 → 'Strong'. When length>=8 but only 2 categories satisfied (e.g. 'abcdefg1'), the current code still shows 'Good' label even though `strong` is false and submit stays disabled — the label is slightly misleading. Consider deriving the label from a `strong` boolean too (e.g. force 'Fair' until strong).

AdvisorClients.jsx buildBookPdf uses `doc.splitTextToSize(cover_note, W-28)` and `Math.min(30, lines.length*5)+6` — a cover_note longer than ~6 lines will overlap the first household row because the y offset is clamped at 30. Either page-break properly or expand the clamp.

server.py POST /api/owners auto-generates a client_id in write_scope() when none is provided, but the response returns the owner document (incl. scope.client_id). Front-end relies on `data.scope.client_id` — fine, but there is no explicit `household_id` field; consider returning `{owner, household_id}` for clarity so the next household_id-aware endpoint (profile/accounts) does not need to drill into scope.

server.py GET /api/advisor/clients does not include a `created_at` for new households so the queue sort is purely by score; the newly-created empty household gets score 0 → always first in default sort. Minor UX gap: show a 'New' chip or filter 'Needs setup' households separately.
